It isn't long until the entire team meets up with him again, and Ray comes face to face with the stranger's incredible abilities like leaping, flying and jumping through the air, not to mention Beyblading like a world champion. He calls himself Mystel and amazes Lee and Ray with the mixture of his incredible acrobatics and Beyblading skills. Lee imagines how good the White Tiger X team would be if they knew how to move like Mystel, and, after challenging their new guest to a battle, has high hopes that he'll share his secrets. But Lee is humiliated by a quick loss, and now it's up to Ray to represent the team in it's own backyard! Can he beat Mystel, and more importantly, can he find out the secrets behind this mysterious young Beyblader?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson can't seem to make up his mind whether or not to trust Boris and go pro. When the team is visited by a rabid pack of sponsors who want to sign them to product contracts, Grandpa is forced to step in and recommend that Tyson have a talk with his more experienced brother, Hiro. While looking for Hiro, Tyson and friends come across Tala, Bryan and Spencer, who are on their way to get revenge on Boris by bringing the BEGA league down around him. Tyson is torn between following Tala, and respecting Tala's wish that he stay out of it.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: An intense battle is played out on the stadium floor, when, it looks like Tala is about to lose, bars rise up out of the floor and keep him in the dish. As they continue to battle, Tala becomes weaker and weaker and collapses. Tyson's had enough. He yells out at Boris telling him his whole BEGA outfit is bogus and he challenges the shadowy figure to a battle. Boris accepts the challenges and at stake is the future of the BEGA and Tyson's future as a Beyblader!! Most of Tyson's friends surround him in a show of support, except one. Kai walks out of the stands and walks right by Tyson leaving him high and dry!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In response to Tyson's challenge of a one on one battle against the best Blader in BEGA, Boris counters by suggesting a five on five match. Tyson wants to accept but the odds are stacked against him. Kai has now joined the BEGA Blader's and BEGA now virtually controls the whole sport because they have set up an I.D. registration service for all Blader's who want to become professionals. Worst of all, Hiro, Tyson's brother has been hired on to coach the BEGA Blader's! Tyson tells his troubles to Ray but gets no sympathy. Secretly Ray has always wanted to battle Tyson when he was at his championship best so he challenges his old friend. An intense battle ensues with Tyson eventually coming out the winner. Ray is satisfied but his blade and Tyson's is ruined. With no hope of getting replacement parts the team decides to build their own blades and go face the BEGA Blader's in battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Hiro stuns the world by joining the BEGA League and coaching Brooklyn, their secret weapon. As the popularity of the new league rises, BBA Revolution find themselves unable to practice because Boris has cornered the market on new parts. Boris is satisfied with the progress of his top Blader's, who are training heavily in a series of practice and exhibition matches. Ming Ming and the rest of her teammates easily dispatch the competition.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Daichi disguise themselves in an effort to get badly needed replacement parts for their damaged Beyblades. But without an official BEGA I.D. card signifying membership in the new league ' something they steadfastly refuse to get - they're shut out from getting parts at any store. Despairing about how they'll solve this dilemma, they're visited by members of various teams they fought against in the World Championships: White Tiger X, PPB All Starz, Barthez Battalion, and F Dynasty. These former foes don't like Boris and his professional BEGA league either, seeing this new entity as a threat to the sport of Beyblading. They vow to help Tyson and the other members of the BBA Revolution in whatever way they can to overthrow BEGA.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The good news is, the Hard Metal Beyblades are ready to go'the bad news: no one knows how to control them! Tyson, Daichi, Ray and Max each spend the day trying to learn the delicate new intricacies of the Hard Metal Beyblade, but the new blades seem to get the better of our heroes over and over again'some even wind up headfirst in the lake'No real progress is being made'It isn't until the gang remembers what it was like when they first started Beyblading, including all the roadblocks that they once came across, that they realize the secret of reining in their new spinners'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson, Max and Ray struggle to learn the 'Hard Metal' system with the help of some of their friends from the World Championship tournament. They still need one more member for the team, and Rick, Lee and Michael have all volunteered to fill the remaining slot. But first they have to prove they can master the new system'which proves a lot tougher than they thought.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bega Bladers have one more Blader to pick for the BEGA 5 Justice Tournament and it's between the up and coming Brooklyn and Kai. As their elimination battle begins, Kai tries his best to take command but it seems Brooklyn mirrors his every move. Kai realizes something's fishy, but before he can do anything about it, Brooklyn takes the win, much to Boris's liking.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the start of 'Justice 5' and Daichi is set to battle Ming Ming, the crowd favorite because of her cute demeanor and sensational singing voice. Daichi's goal is to prove that Ming Ming doesn't take Beyblading seriously and he vows to knock her out of the stadium early in the match. However, when Ming Ming gains the upper hand this makes Daichi very annoyed. Worst of all, Ming Ming has the nerve to break into song as if to mock Daichi. Even worse, her singing seems to make her Blading improve and she slams Strata Dragoon relentlessly. Kenny, a devoted fan of Ming Ming's, realizes that it's her voice that helps her concentrate on her blade and Tyson tells Daichi of her secret. Daichi uses his own voice to unleash the full power of Strata Dragoon but in the end Ming Ming proves to be the better blader and wins the match. Daichi is disappointed but being a good sportsman he congratulates Ming Ming. Tyson and the others realize that the Bega Bladers intend to fight fairly and they all vow to do their very best to win the next battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the second match of the Justice Five Battle and Ray and Crusher are facing off against each other. With Ming Ming's win against Daichi in the previous match, the BEGA League is already ahead by one so the pressure is on Ray to take the match. But Crusher is feeling the pressure too, not only for himself and his teammates but for his sister, Monica, who is undergoing surgery at the very same time. From the beginning, the battle is fierce with both Blader's inflicting significant damage. But Ray quickly gains the upper hand and it looks like its game over. It is only once Crusher calls upon the spirit of his brave, little sister that he is filled with the courage and strength necessary to match Ray. But with so much at stake, which Blader will emerge victorious?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The first two matches of the 'Justice 5' tournament are complete, and things aren't looking good for Tyson's squad, G Revolutions. BEGA's team is up two games to one in the best-of-five series. If they lose another match, BEGA will be victorious and have complete control over the sport of Beyblading. This puts a lot of pressure on Max to win game three against Mystel. Tyson and the others argue whether Max's signature defensive style will be enough to overcome Mystel's unpredictable and overpowering attack. Max takes this as a sign that his teammates only think he can win if he changes the way he Beyblades altogether. His confidence shattered, Max isolates himself and does some soul-searching. He receives a morale boost from a unlikely source ' Rick, his contentious PPB All Starz partner.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: With three rounds already played, the G Revolutions team finds themselves with an unimpressive record' two matches lost, and one ending in a draw. Tyson and the rest of the team are practicing furiously to guarantee a check in the win column for tomorrow's big match. The bad news is, no one on the team has the same skill with the Hard Metal Beyblade as Tyson does' or at least that's what he thinks, and he refuses to choose any of his teammates to Blade in the last round of the tournament, insisting instead to blade both rounds himself. As all of the others vie for the last spot, Kai's frustration at his lack of control with his new Hard Metal Beyblade reaches an all-time high, combine that with his anger at what happened to Tala, and Kai's mood is even less cheery than usual. It isn't until he connects with an unlikely Blading opponent that he gains the technique he's been seeking for so long'the real question is, will Tyson and the rest of the gang welcome Kai back after all they've been through in the past?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the continuation of the Justice 5 Tournament with the BEGA Blader's leading the battle with two wins and a tie. If G Revolutions lose the next battle, they're out and BEGA (lead by the evil Boris) takes over the Beyblading Empire. The next battle is set to pit Tyson against Garland, but when the G Revolutions enter the stadium, they reveal their fifth team member- KAI!! Everyone is stunned, except for the BEGA Blader's who see him only as a loser. Kai is out for revenge because a few days earlier he lost a battle to Brooklyn. So, wanting to save face, Kai calls out Brooklyn, who arrogantly accepts his challenge. A massive battle ensues with Kai trying desperately to somehow attack his opponent, but nothing seems to work. And what's worse, Brooklyn seems to be copying Kai's every move. Kai becomes frustrated and realizes he must dig deep within himself to draw out more power. He does, however, it's making him weaker and weaker. The rest of the G Revolutions team wants him to quit. Kai refuses and in the end, he prepares for a final assault against his foe!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The battle of 'Justice 5 Tournament' continues and Kai is clearly overwhelmed by the power of Brooklyn of the Bega Bladers. Attack after attack sees Kai barely hanging on as he fights to stay in the match. Tyson and his team mates nervously watch, but vow to stay out of the battle because of a promise that Tyson made to Kai. Pleased with the progress of the battle and confident that Brooklyn will win, Boris watches from the sidelines with delight. Kai's determination to win against these unbeatable odds begins to frustrate Brooklyn and he increases the intensity of his attacks. Suddenly, when it seems that Kai can't take any more he manages to draw upon his Beyblading spirit and defeat Brooklyn. The crowd goes wild at this dramatic upset and Kai leaves the stadium only to collapse into Tyson's arms, battered and bruised. Brooklyn remains in the stadium, stunned and confused after suffering the first defeat of his Beyblading career. Kai assures his concerned team mates that he's all right and tells Tyson that he should be more concerned with his upcoming battle against Garland. Tyson, as confident as ever, shrugs Kai's advice off but secretly hopes he can summon the same amazing strength that his old friend showed in his battle. Kai walks unsteadily out of the stadium alone, collapses again, and then watches as Dranzer disintegrates in front of him.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: All of G Revolutions hopes now rest on Tyson's match with Garland. Tyson is determined to make sure Kai's brave victory over Brooklyn isn't wasted. Garland is confident he will win. His family have been sports champions for centuries thanks to a book containing the Tzebult Principles of Victory. Those who follow the principles never lose! Tyson seeks the help of his friends to prepare, finding comfort and focus in their company. The match begins and Garland seems unbeatable due to the family principles. But Tyson isn't satisfied' he wants to fight the real Garland, not a book of rules. Tyson convinces Garland to abandon the family code and Beybattle like a true Blader. But can he withstand the full force of Garland unleashed?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Brooklyn has gone a little loopy after his loss against Kai. And the loss means either BEGA or the G Revolutions need one more victory to win the Justice 5 Tournament. To determine a winner, one battle is left and it will pit Tyson going up against one of the BEGA Blader's. But who will it be? Garland offers his services, but Hiro turns him down cold saying they need Brooklyn to fight this battle. Brooklyn's on the brink of a breakdown and now it's up to Hiro to get him back into fighting form.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The final match between the G Revolutions and the BEGA Bladers has arrived. Tyson prepares for the contest, unsure of whom he will ultimately face. It isn't until he steps onto the stadium floor when he discovers that he will go face to face, against Brooklyn himself. Brooklyn shows off his incredible powers immediately, stunning both teams on either side of the Beystadium. But no one has any idea of the true extent of Brooklyn's powers until he creates a wormhole to another dimension, creating an empty shell, carbon copy of the real world! The freak out continues as Brooklyn destroys everything in his new empty world to mold it into an image that makes him happy! Tyson has never faced an opponent like this! Does he stand a chance, or will BEGA continue its evil infection of the Beyblading community?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's mid-way through Tyson and Brooklyn's final tie-breaking 'Justice 5' match which could give BEGA a stranglehold on the entire sport of Beyblading. Having suffered his only previous defeat at the hands of Kai, Brooklyn's thirst for revenge takes the form of an unearthly power. Not only has his Beyblade Zeus given Brooklyn sinister black wings with which to fly, it's generated a giant vortex in the sky that is wreaking havoc on the city. Buildings are crumbling everywhere. The entire world is being enveloped by the growing darkness. Only Tyson can stop Brooklyn before it's too late. Summoning his own formidable power from Dragoon, Tyson flies into the sky to convince Brooklyn to cease the negative emotions that are causing the havoc. When reasoning fails, the pair continues their battle above the ever-crumbling city. The tide turns in Tyson's favor when he's able to summon the spirits of his teammates' blades and merge them with Dragoon, which evolves into the most powerful Beyblade ever. By probing deeper into Brooklyn's psyche, Tyson learns that his foe's anxiety stems from childhood isolation at being a genius so early in life. Tyson makes Brooklyn see that Beyblading is a pure sport to be enjoyed for one reason alone ' the love of the game. Brooklyn calms down. The chaos ends. And the pair continues their match simply for enjoyment. With BEGA's HQ in shambles, the upstart league and its owner Boris are ruined. Mr. Dickenson's BBA league restarts, but in a much more modest form. And kids everywhere ' including Tyson and his friends - return to the simple, purest form of Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is at home practicing martial arts with his grandfather when suddenly he realizes he's late for a Beyblade battle with Andrew. As he runs out of his house he's confronted by a couple of bullies who only slow him up for his real battle. But when Tyson does show up, Andrew and his friends are met by a smart mouthed kid named Carlos who's a member of the notorious Blade Sharks. Carlos challenges anyone to a battle but the winner gets to keep the others Beyblades. Tyson accepts. With the help of Kenny and his Bit Beast Dizzi, who's trapped inside his laptop, Tyson prepares for the big battle, which he handily wins. But the just when the fight is over, the Blade Shark's leader Kai shows up and a new battle begins between Kai and Tyson

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson battles Kai one on one, but to his surprise, Tyson quickly loses. The Chief informs Tyson, that in order to beat Kai, you need a strategy, so Tyson goes home in an attempt to practice until he's perfected his fighting technique. Later that day, Andrew and Kenny, along with Dizzi show up and attempt to increase the power of Tyson's blade to match that of Kai, but with little success. Tyson is feeling glum about his chances of ever beating Kai, but suddenly, out of nowhere, the Bit Beast Dragoon appears and flies straight towards him and goes directly into Tyson's beyblade. Tyson is stunned after realizing Dragoon does exists and is now inside his beyblade. With renewed confidence, Tyson knows the time is right to challenge Kai once again to do battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In a moment of heroism, Max, the new Beyblader in town, shows Tyson that with the proper skill and training, there is nothing that can't be achieved. The two soon become fast friends, leaving Kenny feeling left out.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Beyblade Regional Qualifying Tournament is underway as Tyson, Max, Ray and even Kenny are entered to see if they can dethrone Kai, the reigning champion. As our announcers, Brad Best and A.J. Topper rev up the crowd, Kenny is first into battle but without a Bit Beast in his blade, he falls quickly to Kai.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Max is completely overpowered in his semi-finals match against Kai. It's not until the Bit Beast known as Draciel emerges from Max's Grandmother's pendant, to add its power to Max's Beyblade that the tables begin to turn.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Qualifying Tournament is in its final stages as Tyson has advanced to face Ray in the semi-finals. As the best of three battles gets underway, Tyson's bravado quickly fades as Ray handily wins the first round when he destroys Tyson's Beyblade with his famous Tiger Claw Attack.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The National Beyblade Championship Match is set, with Tyson facing off against reigning champion, Kai. It's not until Grandpa throws a surprise party for Tyson, that the rookie sensation realizes he's forgotten his own Birthday!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and his team prepare for the Hong Kong world championships. Kai seems to reject his newfound team and leads them on a chase through the streets. That's where the guys learn some lessons about Beyblading from some very mysterious 'bladers. After a decisive victory, Tyson and the gang discover that the alley bladders make up the membership of 'The White Tiger Team'' Whatever that is'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Our heroes arrive in Hong Kong on a stop-over to the Asian Beyblade Tournament when they run into Ray's old gang the White Tigers. A confrontation quickly ensues with no one coming out the clear winner.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The first round of the Asian Tournament sees the Bladebreakers facing off against the team called the Tall-Boys, with Ray's ex-teammates, The White Tigers, waiting in the wings.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The night before the Asian Tournament, Kevin decides to steal data from Kenny's laptop to get the edge for his White Tiger Team. Unfortunately, Kenny catches him red-handed which sets up a battle between Ray and Kevin, which ends in dire consequences for Ray.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After realizing his Bit Beast is gone, Ray decides to head for the mountains in an attempt to get it back. Tyson and Mariah give chase and confront Ray to decide which team he wants to be on.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The White Tiger Team faces off against the Spin-Shepards in the quarterfinals of the Asian Tournament. When Ray sees that Lee is also using the 'Tiger Claw' attack, he is forced to finally open up to his teammates about his mysterious past.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the morning of the semi-finals at the Asian Beyblade Tournament and Tyson manages to sleep in. The rest of the team leaves early, but Ray stays behind to make sure Tyson wakes up. As the tournament gets underway, Max is the first to battle. Meanwhile, Ray and Tyson are caught up in a traffic jam created by a landslide, so they decide to walk. But the shortest route is over a mountain where Ray sprains his ankle and Tyson is left to carrying him all the way to there.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The finals are about to begin in the Asian Qualifying Tournament with the winning team advancing to the World Beyblading Championships. In the first round, Max goes against Gary from the White Tigers in a best of three battle. The first round goes without a hitch as Max easily takes care of his opponent and with the win, Max becomes a little over confident.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: During the finals of the Asian Tournament, Ray faces off against his old teammate, and former friend, Mariah. When Galux and Driger team up to show the pair a glimpse of the happiness they shared in the past, Ray and Mariah come to realize how much they have lost, by being rivals.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The final match of the Asian Beyblade Tournament reaches an uncertain conclusion when Tyson and Lee's decisive battle ends in a draw. The resulting sudden death session between Ray and Lee rekindles the pair's old hometown grievances.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Fresh from the Bladebreakers win in Asia, Tyson comes home and realizes he's front page news! With his ego out of control, Tyson takes on the attitude of a rock star, which upsets Kenny who tries to keep him focused on blading and not his popularity. Meanwhile, at a local playground, the local kids are all out Beyblading when Tyson spots a kid (Nicky), being smoked in the Beystadium by a bully (Riley). After Nicky's blade is completely destroyed, Tyson vows to help the kid fix it and fight his way back.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in the USA for the American Tournament. During a tour of a BBA research facility, Max is shocked to learn that his Mom works there, and not at the college, like he thought. To make matters worse, the team discovers that they are being tested for weaknesses, by a competing team.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After their non-competition loss to Emily of the All Starz at the BBA Research Center, the Blade Breakers sneak around the high-tech facility, hoping to learn more about their competition. There, they confront two other All Starz, and Max learns more about his Mom's job at the BBA - specifically, a rumor of why Max wasn't asked to join the All Starz Team.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: For some strange reason, Mr. Dickenson has sent the Blade Breakers to a remote mountain retreat to hone their blading skills for the upcoming American Tournament as well as to get Kenny and Dizzi to figure out a way to increase Ray's Bit Beast's power. Once there, they meet up with a enthusiastic young boy named Antonio who they think is there to train them. Turns out, Antonio is a pathetic blader.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A charity event in the Heartland of America gives the Bladebreakers a taste of the All Starz' prowess. Featuring celebrities in a three-on-three contest against young Beybladers of note, Emily of the All Starz, bullies her way to an easy win. It isn't until Emily knocks out her own opponent, loses the second match and is on her way to throwing the whole competition, that Max teaches her what teamwork is all about.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Las Vegas for the start of the American Tournament. Tyson looks forward to facing off against the arrogant All-Starz, and their scientifically advanced Beyblades'but first his team needs to get past the 'Renegades' in the qualifying round. Kai surprises everyone by stepping into the dish for the first battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Blade Breakers have advanced to the second round of the American Tournament where they square off against the Savage Slammers. The winner of this round advances to the semi-finals. Their competition first appears to be a bunch of slackers, but when Ray loses out in the first round, they quickly realize what they're up against. Max is next, and for some odd reason, his rival folds under pressure, so the best of three is tied at one a piece with Tyson coming in for the deciding battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the Bladebreakers versus Spintensity in the semi-finals of the American Tournament. But before the match can begin, Tyson is forced to withdraw with a stomachache he got from too much celebratory eating. Max, Ray and Kai must drag race their crafty foes through the whirlwind, highway-themed dish called the New Jersey Turnpike.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tensions rise as the American Tournament heats up. Max fights for a chance to beyblade against his mother's team the All-Starz in an upcoming match, while Tyson and the rest of the Bladebreakers realize that the All-Starz are a bigger threat then they previously thought. At the end of two tense rounds, Tyson and Steven are tied one-all'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the finals of the American Tournament and the Bladebreakers are going head to head with the All Starz with the winner going to the World Championships. In the first round, Tyson is pitted against Steve and at first things don't appear to be going Tyson's way. But with sheer determination, Tyson pulls out a victory that puts the Bladebreakers ahead one to nothing in the best of three finals.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The deciding match of the American Tournament Finals comes down to Max vs. Michael of the 'All Starz,' in a battle that pits science and technology against human spirit. Unfortunately for Max and the Bladebreakers, the trick dish turns out to be a replica of a baseball diamond'where Michael feels right at home!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After narrowly defeating the All Starz at the American Tournament, Kenny decides he should record a database of the highs and low points of the BladeBreakers since the very beginning. In fact, through a series of flashbacks, the Chief along with Dizzi, takes a trip down memory lane as far back to the first time he ever met Tyson. With clips from various shows, Kenny narrates the progress of his friends who eventually form the BladeBreakers and go on to the Asian Tournament.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: Freed by an unlikely liberator, Ross's escape is interrupted by Mustang. Even those most loyal to the Flame Alchemist are shaken by the controversial action he takes against the accused killer of Maes Hughes.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: Ed's journey to a distant land of legend offers surprising new details behind Mustang's alleyway encounter with Ross. After a fateful encounter of his own, Elric learns a stunning secret about Winry's parents.

programme.desc: Tokyo is suddenly hit by a massive bombing. Two young men who call themselves “Sphinx” start an epic game involving the whole of Japan.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: The great thief Rat Boy Jirokichi IV appears before Goemon and reveals that their ancestors competed in the first International Thieves Championship together, but were defeated by Lupin's grandfather, Arsène Lupin. programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: The match between Ishiyama and the 6 Holy Knights is here, and this is not your usual volleyball! With their pride and their educational future on the line, the Ishiyama gang puts it all out there on the court! Will Furuichi the Strategist be their trump card?

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

Meanwhile, Shishigami confronts a group of delinquents who have been tormenting his best friend Naoyuki Ando.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: When the fully tattooed yakuza criminal Samejima finds a girl he likes, he kidnaps them, drugs them up, and then roughs them up. Fumino was happy. She had a job and a fiance. But one night, Samejima sets his sights on her, and has his men kidnap her. Fumino manages to escape, and runs to her fiance Satoru's house, but Samejima is in hot pursuit. Inuyashiki comes to save them, but gets shot.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ando is struggling with the fact that his friend Shishigami is responsible for the spree of home invasions. After reading that hospital patients were being cured, Ando theorizes that there is someone else out there with the same powers as Shishigami. Ando lures Inuyashiki by pretending to need help and asks him to stop Shishigami. Meanwhile, Shishigami learns his mother has terminal cancer.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kaito goes up against a Syndicate-owned pool hall hustler to win back the Legendary Cue, a treasure once owned by Jii before he was cheated it out of it by the Syndicate boss many years ago. However, things look dire when Jii's pool hall is put on the line and Kaito apparently has no skill with the game.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: A brilliant if arrogant teen detective comes to town, determined to capture Kid the Phantom Thief. This turns the heat up for Kaito, especially since they're classmates. In fact, Kaito becomes Suguru's rival even out of uniform, leading to a "gentlemen's bet" over which of them will go on a date with Aoko.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kaito has a new classmate, Akako, who appears to possess genuine magic abilities, the kind that bend everyone to her will... except for Kaito and his alter ego, Kid the Phantom Thief! Who will come out on top in the inevitable showdown, sorceress or illusionist?

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: Mustang, Alphonse, Havoc, and Hawkeye split up to search a military laboratory. If Lust has her way, none of them will ever see each other alive again.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: Hohenheim's visit ends with a grave warning to Pinako, but Ed finds hope among the charred ruins of his childhood. Now more than ever, he has confidence that Al can be returned to his body.

programme.desc: Great Destinations of the World takes you to some of the most beautiful and exotic places on the planet. programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Sugar is commonly known on the island as the Mauritian Miracle, having once been the backbone of Mauritius's economy. Brent visits L'Adventure du Sucre museum and gets a fascinating look at how the Mauritian history is tightly intertwined with sugar. He then heads in to the fields to for some fun cutting cane before meeting up with Chef Oliver and who shows Brent just how much Mauritians love sugar and spice. Brent then heads out to the stunning and exclusive island, Ile Des Deux Cocos, for some snorkeling in a marine sanctuary and then cooks up his own Mauritian tropical desert on a remote coral beach.

programme.title: Sarah Graham’s Food Safari
programme.desc: Food blogger and cookbook author, Sarah Graham, takes her kitchen on the road through Africa.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In our first episode, you find us at a boatyard in the small fishing town of Chioggia - at the southern end of the Venice Lagoon, preparing the yacht for its voyage. We will show you around this lovely town, and introduce you to some of the colourful people we’ve come to know here over the years. Chioggia is the busiest fishing port on all of mainland Italy; we will take you to its fish markets, and meet a restaurateur in the kitchen of one of Chioggia’s finest restaurants to see the chefs cook some local specialties. We also go fishing with a father and son, who practice an ancient tradition of net and pole fishing on the Venetian Lagoon. They are called moecanti.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In this second episode, we sail into Venice and visit our friend Renato, who has been the head chef at the Cipriani Hotel for over 25 years and has travelled the world as a food ambassador. Renato invites us into his kitchen to make some of his best-loved Venetian dishes. We then visit the famous Rialto markets and cook a few of my favourites in the yacht’s galley. We conclude our Venice adventure by visiting some friends at an old gondola repair yard called a squero. It has been converted into a private retreat featuring an impressive kitchen, from which we experience a memorable Venetian cook-up.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In this episode, we sail all the way to southern Turkey to visit the picturesque village of Kaleköy in the Kekova area. We introduce you to a local family who run the Likya restaurant, and serve simple delicious Turkish food. We’ve known them for over 30 years, ever since we began sailing here. We also discover how the locals love the carob bean, and how they make a tasty, healthy syrup from it. Finally, we’ll introduce you to our friend Kadriye who cooks up a typical Turkish lunch, and one of her neighbours demonstrates how to make the local pancake called gözleme.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: As our long voyage from Venice continues, we sail from Kastellorizo to Lindos on the island of Rhodes. This is where Patrick and I married, over 30 years ago. In Lindos, we take you to the Melenos kitchen; where the chef, Gogo, will show us her very modern & healthy take on traditional Greek cuisine. We visit Rhodes, where I used to teach ballet, and show you how to prepare artichokes with vinaigrette sauce, the dish that Patrick prepared for me on our very first date! Finally, we visit my godfather, Vangelis, who shows us how to prepare some authentic everyday Greek food.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In this episode, we will take you to the beautiful Greek island of Symi, where the amphitheatrical harbour displays its distinctive neo classical architecture, very specific to this particular corner of the Aegean. Here we’ll recapture old memories, and cook the local delicacy - Symi shrimps. Our next stop is the extraordinary island of Santorini, where we will celebrate their famous tomatoes, grown in the rich volcanic soil. Finally, we head northwest to the mouth of the Corinth canal - the location of one of our all-time favourite seafood restaurants in the Mediterranean. It’s called Kavos and is run by Pagona and her son, Tassos.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In this episode, we will sail through the Corinth canal in Greece, cross to the boot of Italy and sail all the way up the west coast to Liguria, to one of our favourite towns – Sestri Levante. On the way, we will stop at Galaxidi, halfway up the Gulf of Corinth, for breakfast after which I will prepare a Moussaka in the galley – under sail. We will then take you to Amalfi and the bay of Naples to pay homage to their lemons and to the Caprese salad, before arriving in the village of Sestri Levante to experience some delicious Ligurian dishes.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In Portofino, we’ll be shown how to make the authentic version of pesto alla Genovese, by chef Corrado at the legendary Hotel Splendido. We will then visit the Canale bakery to see how they make the famous local bread called focaccia; and after that, we will meet up with my dear friend Nina on the yacht in Portofino’s iconic harbour, which is where we met over 25 years ago. She wants to show us how to make a couple of delicious dishes, in the galley.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In this, the final episode, we sail along the French Riviera and catch up with some of the people and places we know and love. This region is particularly dear to Patrick; he was born in Marseille and spent all of his childhood summers on this coast. First, we’ll visit St Tropez, including the iconic Club 55; then we’ll take you to Antibes and to a couple of nearby villages, St Paul de Vence and Biot. Each has a restaurant which we count among our favourites, and they have two things in common – traditional Provençal food… and art, which in each case is largely its raison d’être.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Wilker y Yubiri siguen besándose. Cada uno de ellos pensando en lo feliz que se sienten. El se despide de ella y quedan en no hablarse más. Carolina le forma un escándalo a Segundo por besarla pero piensa que le gusta más que los besos de Juan Diego. Se van del local. Atanasio sigue aconsejando a Juan Diego en lo que se refiere a las mujeres. Wilker anima a su mamá a que se consiga un novio para que la acompañe. Ella le dice que no | que lo que quieres es que se case y tenga bastantes nietos.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel León es un famoso presentador televisivo famoso por su vitalidad y buena presencia pero en uno de sus programas sufre un desmayo y entonces va al médico y este le dice que deberá hacer un tratamiento de diálisis o hacerse un trasplante. Gabriel le confiesa esta verdad a su manager y amigo Epicúreo y también le dice que el donante será uno de sus hijos que no conoce pero que sabe que existen porque cuando tenía 18 años fue donante de esperma y le encarga a Epicúreo que se ocupe de encontrar a esos hijos. Epicúreo se hace pasar por diferentes roles y consigue la información que Gabriel estaba buscando o al menos algo de ella.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Amparo revela a Moisés que su padre está vivo, desatando tensiones familiares mientras Elizabeth exige la verdad. Benjamín anuncia su boda con Hortensia, provocando el rechazo de Ricardo, quien exige separación de bienes. Alejandro intenta disuadir a su padre de una venganza sangrienta tras salir de prisión. Mientras tanto, Gustavo busca a María del Pilar pese a que ella ya está con Marcelo, y Manuela rechaza la propuesta de Misael en medio de conflictos familiares y sociales.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Adolfo reclama a Isaías por el dinero perdido y lo acusa de vivir con Rosa; Isaías defiende a Rosa diciendo que podría ser su hija. Salvador rompe con Vilma quien jura venganza. Erasto descubre que el dinero desapareció y culpa a Eustoquio. Junior se enfrenta a Rosa por Isaías y cae desmayado; ella lo lleva a la clínica gritando auxilio. Alejandro enfrenta a Erasto y lo amenaza con la Fiscalía. Erasto coloca camisa de fuerza a Natalia y la golpea. Carmen Rosa explica a Chencha por qué calla la verdad sobre Consuelo, jurándole no revelar nunca el secreto.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene y Leonardo vuelven del viaje y Felipe los espera ansioso. Alejandra se entera de que se filtró un correo donde piden a alguien para su puesto y confronta a Leonardo, quien la saca violentamente de su oficina. Rodrigo amenaza a Rebeca con revelar todo el plan si Adolfo y ella deciden traicionarlos. Además, le pregunta qué pasaría si se supiera que ella es la asesina de Miguel Ferrándiz. Anzola le declara su amor a Trinidad y esta lo rechaza. Jimena tiene una dura conversación con Carlos Ernesto en la cual él le pide que lo deje amar a Virginia. Luego, Jimena se enfrenta a Virginia y le confiesa que tiene dudas sobre la autoría del crimen. Virginia le dice que ama a Carlos Ernesto y que luchará con todo para limpiar su nombre.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: El socio de Heriberto lo visita en la cárcel para confesarle que ahora se alió con Reina para secuestrar a Alejandro, ya que ella le pagará más.Reina lleva sedado a Alejandro a un hotel y lo hace pasar por parapléjico, pero cuando sale olvida su teléfono, y Alejandro aprovecha para llamar a Sol y contarle que lo tienen ahí, y también pedirle que llame a la policía. Luego Reina regresa antes que Alejandro escape, y se lo lleva junto a su nuevo socio en una camioneta.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Carlos Ernesto y Leonardo hablan acerca de las sospechas del segundo sobre la verdadera paternidad de Mateo, el hijo de Irene. Sin que ellos lo sepan, Rebeca los está escuchando. Virginia y Jimena se reconcilian y le comunican la buena nueva a Carlos Ernesto, quien se muestra feliz y agradecido. Leo es liberado de la cárcel y se reencuentra con su padre. En una molesta discusión, pregunta si cuando se vuelvan a casar, van a firmar la separación de bienes. Sandra invita a salir a Fernando para poder mostrarle que María Lucía está de novia y muy feliz con Damián. Trinidad le cuenta a Zulay la propuesta de Anzola y Zulay la insta a aceptarla. Al mismo tiempo, Anzola se lamenta con Coromoto por la negativa de Trinidad.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Heriberto logra escapar de la cárcel y le pasa información a Maricielo sobre el posible escondite al que Reina irá con Alejandro. La policía consigue dar con los secuestradores y recuperar sano y salvo a Alejandro, pero Reina se da a la fuga. A último momento, es interceptada por las patrullas. Luego, Heriberto se dirige a la casa de Sol y le dice que ha ayudado a la policía para recuperar a Alejandro. Ella confía en él pero, al momento de brindar, Heriberto le pone una droga en su bebida.

programme.title: Mia y el león blanco
programme.desc: Mia se muda a Sudáfrica con su familia para hacerse cargo de una granja de leones y allí desarrolla un vínculo especial con Charlie, un cachorro blanco. Sin embargo, todo cambia cuando descubre el secreto de su padre.

programme.title: El Retador
programme.desc: Un mecánico con mala suerte, con la ayuda de un legendario entrenador de boxeo, debe pasar de luchador callejero a boxeador profesional para encontrar una vida mejor para él y su madre enferma.

programme.title: Mia y el león blanco
programme.desc: Mia se muda a Sudáfrica con su familia para hacerse cargo de una granja de leones y allí desarrolla un vínculo especial con Charlie, un cachorro blanco. Sin embargo, todo cambia cuando descubre el secreto de su padre.

programme.title: Platillo Estatal
programme.desc: Las cosas se calientan en Colorado, Taylor tuesta chiles verdes, recoge melones, prueba maíz dulce y las famosas ostras de las Rocallosas.

programme.title: Cerco de Terror 26/11 – La Serie
programme.desc: Durante el interrogatorio, Kasab revela detalles de su adoctrinamiento, su reclutamiento por parte de Lashkar-e-Toiba y el funcionamiento de los campos de entrenamiento terroristas. Este capítulo ofrece una mirada más profunda detrás de los ataques.

programme.title: Un Milagro en Texas
programme.desc: Un Milagro en Texas es una comedia desternillante que se desarrolla en el corazón de la Gran Depresión. John Ratzenberger y Kevin Sorbo brillan interpretando a dos astutos estafadores que urden un plan para conquistar a viudas y convencerlas de invertir en sus aparentemente inútiles empresas de pozos de petróleo. Las risas no se hacen esperar mientras las viudas luchan con sus decisiones, solo para que la situación se invierta cuando un giro inesperado del destino conduce a un auténtico hallazgo de petróleo.

programme.title: Hemingway
programme.desc: Tras la muerte del propietario del imperio editorial Hemingway, su familia está interesada en su herencia. Sin embargo, rápidamente se enteran de una estipulación en el testamento: deben dejar de lado sus problemas y reparar la brecha que los divide en 8 horas, o no heredarán nada.

programme.title: Great Inventions
programme.desc: La cerveza es una de las bebidas más antiguas y extendidas de la historia de la humanidad. Forma parte de nuestra cultura y de nuestra vida cotidiana desde hace más de 10.000 años.

programme.title: Camapamento en Heritage
programme.desc: El entrenador lleva a su hijo y a su nieto que abandonó la escuela a una cabaña para pasar tres días de introspección y aventureras.

programme.title: Ashley Jones es Perfectamente Normal
programme.desc: La reportera Ace Ashley Jones es una joven perfectamente normal con una vida perfectamente normal, un trabajo normal y una prometida normal hasta que conoce a una mujer que dice tener 500.000 años y le empiezan a suceder cosas extrañas.

programme.title: Felices 140
programme.desc: Elia cumple 40 años y, para celebrarlo, reune en una lujosa casa rural a amigos y familiares. Tiene que decirles algo muy importante que hara que el ambiente empiece a enrarecerse...

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Eduardo le enseña a Octavio a disparar. Días después, Ricardo se casa el mismo día del cumpleaños de Octavio, obviamente Eduardo acapara la plaza del pueblo, horas después, en la salida de la iglesia, la familia Guerrero es atacada por el bando de Moreno: hiriendo a Ricardo y llevándose a Eduardo y a Esmeralda como rehenes, en consecuencia, Eduardo es torturado mientras Esmeralda observa.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: El Ejército llega para dar orden al pueblo, no obstante, cierran las minas de la región, por esto los Mineros y Reina son encerrados en la cárcel. Por otra parte, Esperanza se decepciona cuando Ricardo en coma repite el nombre de Esmeralda, ese mismo día, Esmeralda escapa y los hombres de Moreno son acribillados por el ejército de Eduardo.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: La intervención del ejército empeora la situación. Esmeralda y Ricardo se reconcilian, lo que despierta el rencor de Esperanza. Esa noche, Olga es golpeada por su celoso esposo. Luego, Eduardo finge querer reconciliarse, pero en realidad planea desenmascarar a Esmeralda y Ricardo, haciéndolos quedar mal ante los Guerrero.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Eduardo asesina a Moreno en la mitad del pueblo, detonante para que en el pueblo se forme una revuelta que se sale de control tras el cierre de las minas cerradas. Alcides se une con Eduardo, convirtiéndose en uno de sus lavaperros. Al mismo tiempo, Octavio cae en el vicio y la mala vida. Por esos días los obreros planean atacar a los Guerreros culpándolos de avaros.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Obreros roban en la casa de los Guerrero, pero Alejandro mata a uno y renuncia a la alcaldía. Esa noche descubre la verdad sobre la muerte de Ortega y el matrimonio forzado de Eduardo. Días después, cuando solo empresas privadas pueden licitar, comienzan alianzas en el pueblo, marcando un nuevo rumbo en la disputa por las minas.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Alcides golpea a Olga y el Padre Javier lo enfrenta. Olga pide el divorcio y lo expulsa. Ese día, una explosión ilegal en la mina sepulta a obreros, y Eduardo ordena dejarlos enterrados. Además, excluye a “El Tigre” del negocio, generando su rencor.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Ricardo se postula a la alcaldía mientras Rubén chantajea al Gobernador para quedarse con el cargo. El Padre Javier y Olga se enamoran pese a la oposición de la iglesia, Alcides intenta matarlo y lo hiere. Años después, Alcira regresa para vengarse de Eduardo, quien sigue apoderándose de las minas, generando tensión entre los esmeralderos.

programme.desc: Colón y Aurelio están frente a frente, Corina está malherida, sus signos vitales se desvanecen. El agente de la DEA desespera, entiende que los Casillas tienen el control sobre ella.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio vuelve a escuchar a Mecha y los motivos por los cuales ella no quiere estar con él, le susurra al oído un deseo que la haría muy feliz, pero el miedo la congela.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aguirre avanza en su objetivo, victimizarse lo empuja a los brazos de Rutila, Javi está donde él quiere, lejos y en el blanco, como un hombre celoso capaz de todo, hasta de liquidar a su mujer.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Con el apoyo de "Vitaminas", Aurelio se cuela en las oficinas de Aguirre, debe averiguar de dónde vino el pitazo para el ataque a su hija, más vale que lo consiga. Javi no está en la ecuación.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tracy haciéndose pasar por "La Soberana" consigue lo que buscaba, se encuentra con los Casillas, quiere conocer a Aurelio y lavar dinero para ellos. Rutila, a regañadientes, viaja con su padre.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Después de conocer a Mecha, Rutila le advierte a Aurelio que ella le oculta algo; sabe que como mujer no podría vivir sin él, pero a la vez huele peligro si sigue con Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Berenice no cree que Jaime sea un asesino, Diana intenta protegerla, pero ella más bien se siente secuestrada y le recuerda a su hermana que aún sigue casada con Rosales.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tracy Lobo como "La Soberana" tiene un solo objetivo, engañar a Casillas y atraparlo. Aurelio lanza una pregunta que la pone a prueba, los nervios pueden traicionarla y quedar al descubierto.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Corina está a punto de darle la mejor pista a Aurelio, pero la atacan por la espalda. Colón y Castillo intimidan a Saade para que se convierta en un informante de la DEA.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio siente la presencia de Doña Alba, tiene una profunda conversación con ella, quien le recomienda mirar hacia el pasado, preguntarse para qué tanto poder y cuidar lo que hace actualmente.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Javi asume que fue un patán con Rutila, no hay otra mujer a la que haya querido tanto, le advierte que, si no la libra, recuerde siempre sus labios. La hija de Casillas está angustiada.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Jaime se va de aventuras con Dalila, quien lo ayuda a experimentar al extremo, pero la diversión se acaba cuando Alfaro interrumpe la velada para citarlo en su oficina de emergencia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mecha se queda en Mexicali y esperará a Aurelio, no quiere vivir en medio de la guerra, pero él corre a atender la desaparición de Corina. La Soberana queda obsesionada.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio e Ismael salen a buscar a Corina, ella respira profundo e intenta sobrevivir en medio de la selva, pero antes, Casillas, que sabe cómo lograr lo que quiere, le hace una promesa a Mecha.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Colón y Aurelio están frente a frente, Corina está malherida, sus signos vitales se desvanecen. El agente de la DEA desespera, entiende que los Casillas tienen el control sobre ella.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio vuelve a escuchar a Mecha y los motivos por los cuales ella no quiere estar con él, le susurra al oído un deseo que la haría muy feliz, pero el miedo la congela.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila vuela a Colombia para salvar a Javi, pero el rescate se complica, la instrucción es no aterrizar, por ahora. Al sobrevolar la pista, el piloto resulta herido, llaman a Aurelio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio guía a Javi por teléfono, quien toma el timón para aterrizar el avión que se quedó sin piloto en pleno vuelo. Rutila está en la cabina y trata de ayudar. Su amor se pone a prueba.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Entre besos y abrazos, Aurelio amanece con Mecha, la admiración es mutua y él le pide que no le oculte nada. Aguirre descubre que la sobrina le miente a Zambrana, el tío se entera.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Manzano y Colón tienen motivos para sospechar de Tracy, la acorralan. Benjamín se la juega, cumple con la misión de colarse a la habitación de Saldaña para matarla, pero Carla sospecha.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La curiosidad de Mecha no tiene límites, quiere saber más de Corina y va al hospital con Roberta, lo que no imaginan es a quién más van a encontrar ahí, el susto es grande, se esconden.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mecha le sirve de informante a Aurelio; a escondidas, salen juntos del hospital, pero alguien más los observa, dejarse ver tan bien acompañados puede traerles problemas. Casillas toma medidas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Una hermosa cabaña en medio de la nada es el escenario más romántico para Mecha y Aurelio, donde se dan un espacio para ser lo que quieren ser. Un atentado en la fonda le cuesta muy caro a Artemia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio quiere vivir toda la vida junto a Mecha, pero ella dice que están inmersos en una fantasía. La Felina logra comunicarse con Casillas y lo pone al tanto del ataque a la fonda.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio y Mecha amanecen juntos, al despertar, él le da la mala noticia, furiosa, reclama por qué no se lo dijo antes, él intenta explicar, pero es inútil, la decisión está tomada.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mecha le hace una promesa a Artemia, mientras Aurelio está fuera de sus cabales, es imperdonable lo que pasó en la fonda. Los Rayados, camuflados, entran al hospital, buscan a su objetivo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas promete que lo que va a pasar no lo detiene nadie, como cazador busca a su presa, La Felina lo acompaña y lo incentiva para demoler al enemigo. Colón contacta al Señor de los Cielos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aislados de todo, Colón y Casillas se ven las caras. Es la hora de la verdad. Ismael y Caridad coordinan con Saade mover cinco toneladas de droga bajo la mirada atenta de la DEA.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Platicamos con Adriana “Ady” Jiménez, clavadista mexicana y campeona mundial de clavados de altura, quien nos comparte cómo el deporte marcó cada etapa de su vida. Desde sus inicios en el karate hasta su ingreso al Comité Olímpico Mexicano a los 13 años, Ady Jiménez recuerda la disciplina, los sacrificios y los sueños que la formaron como atleta. Entre anécdotas de infancia, frustraciones como perder un pase olímpico en 2004 y el retiro temporal que la alejó de la plataforma durante una década, la clavadista narra su sorprendente regreso: decretar antes de saltar, vencer el miedo y abrazar la adrenalina de los 20 metros de altura. Hoy, retirada oficialmente desde 2022, Ady busca dejar un legado a través de la nueva federación de clavados, convencida de que el miedo no es un obstáculo, sino un motor. Su historia es un viaje de resiliencia, pasión y amor absoluto por el deporte.

programme.desc: Conversamos con El Coreanito Mateos, ex-boxeador y ahora entrenador, quien comparte su inspiradora trayectoria desde una infancia difícil hasta convertirse en uno de los referentes del boxeo mexicano. Desde su primer encuentro con un gimnasio a los 13 años hasta ganar el prestigioso torneo Guantes de Oro en 1994, Mateos nos relata cómo la disciplina, la pasión y el sacrificio definieron su carrera. El Coreanito nos lleva al corazón del ring: sus mejores peleas, los retos de mantenerse en forma, las derrotas y victorias que marcaron su vida.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Charlamos con Steffy Aradillas, figura del softbol mexicano e integrante del equipo nacional que hizo historia en los Juegos Olímpicos de Tokio 2021. A través de una conversación cercana, Steffy comparte su camino desde la infancia en la Liga Maya hasta convertirse en medallista internacional, profesional con estudios de maestría y una de las voces más inspiradoras del deporte femenino en México.Con anécdotas que van desde su vida en Estados Unidos hasta su participación con los Diablos Rojos, Steffy habla de disciplina, identidad, conexión emocional con el público y el impacto de las mujeres en el diamante. Este episodio nos presenta a una atleta íntegra, auténtica y carismática, que ha hecho del deporte no solo una carrera, sino un canal para transformar realidades y representar con orgullo a su país dentro y fuera del campo.

programme.title: Amor en el Rancho
programme.desc: Allison Sawyer es la reportera de cabecera del Metropolis Post, conocida por sus reportajes de alto nivel. Su próxima historia es escribir el perfil de una de sus autoras favoritas, Annabelle Lee. Annabelle basa todas sus novelas románticas en el hermoso e intemporal rancho Clybourne, lejos de la vida de la ciudad. Allison va al rancho y conoce a Hank y a su adorable abuela Stella, que llevan años regentando juntos el lugar.

programme.title: Cambio De Rumbo
programme.desc: Después de recibir malas noticias sobre la salud de su padre, James regresa a casa de mala gana para ayudar con el negocio familiar, un alojamiento y desayuno. Allí se enfrenta a un trabajo servil que abandonó con entusiasmo antes, y a un hermano con el que no se lleva bien. Aunque anhela irse tan pronto como pueda, descubre que el negocio está teniendo problemas. James enfrenta las tensiones con su hermano y debe decidir qué está dispuesto a sacrificar por los que ama.

programme.title: Aprendiendo A Amar
programme.desc: Cuando su novio la deja, Steph se muda a Los Ángeles y acepta un trabajo como tutora de las hijas de un exitoso arquitecto en los Hamptons. Todo parece perfecto hasta que surgen sentimientos entre ellos, y las niñas deciden intervenir antes de que el romance se venga abajo.

programme.title: Alimento para El Corazón
programme.desc: Los planes de la chef Lia de ampliar su servicio sin ánimo de lucro de reparto de comida a domicilio centrado en el corazón fracasan debido a su insistencia en hacerlo todo ella misma. Pero con la ayuda de su nuevo vecino y reciente padre adoptivo Eli descubrirá que los negocios, al igual que el romance, pueden florecer con un poco de esfuerzo y confianza.

programme.title: Una Amistad Diferente
programme.desc: Después de un período de servicio, una enfermera del ejército regresa a la granja de su abuela en un país Amish. Encuentra un romance inesperado con Grace, quien acude a ella para llevar a su mamá al hospital y se ve envuelta en un misterio de asesinato.

programme.title: Amor De Mentira
programme.desc: Cuando Sarah Goldman, una encantadora y joven maestra de escuela en Chicago, quiere complacer a sus padres, se inventa un novio que cree que será el hombre de los sueños de su madre. Cuando sus padres insisten en conocerlo, Sarah contrata a Bob, un actor, para que se haga pasar por su novio.

programme.title: Enfoque De Amor
programme.desc: Cuando el programa de televisión que protagoniza la actriz Jenna Wilde se cancela repentinamente, la prensa empieza a rodearla. Para escapar del caos, Jenna se retira a una cabaña nevada en las montañas. Inesperadamente, debe compartir este apacible lugar con Chris Dixon, un fotógrafo de naturaleza. Su frialdad mutua empieza a descongelarse cuando Chris ayuda a Jenna a presentarse a las audiciones de otros programas.

programme.title: El Amor no Necesita Traducción
programme.desc: Julie Walters, estudiante de doctorado en lingüística, habla casi todos los idiomas imaginables. Es una gran creyente de que los idiomas se aprenden mejor haciendo actividades divertidas. Las cosas se ponen patas arriba para Julie cuando un empleado de un museo se pone en contacto con ella para que le dé clases de francés.

programme.title: Alimento para El Corazón
programme.desc: Los planes de la chef Lia de ampliar su servicio sin ánimo de lucro de reparto de comida a domicilio centrado en el corazón fracasan debido a su insistencia en hacerlo todo ella misma. Pero con la ayuda de su nuevo vecino y reciente padre adoptivo Eli descubrirá que los negocios, al igual que el romance, pueden florecer con un poco de esfuerzo y confianza.

programme.title: Una Amistad Diferente
programme.desc: Después de un período de servicio, una enfermera del ejército regresa a la granja de su abuela en un país Amish. Encuentra un romance inesperado con Grace, quien acude a ella para llevar a su mamá al hospital y se ve envuelta en un misterio de asesinato.

programme.title: Amor De Mentira
programme.desc: Cuando Sarah Goldman, una encantadora y joven maestra de escuela en Chicago, quiere complacer a sus padres, se inventa un novio que cree que será el hombre de los sueños de su madre. Cuando sus padres insisten en conocerlo, Sarah contrata a Bob, un actor, para que se haga pasar por su novio.

programme.title: Enfoque De Amor
programme.desc: Cuando el programa de televisión que protagoniza la actriz Jenna Wilde se cancela repentinamente, la prensa empieza a rodearla. Para escapar del caos, Jenna se retira a una cabaña nevada en las montañas. Inesperadamente, debe compartir este apacible lugar con Chris Dixon, un fotógrafo de naturaleza. Su frialdad mutua empieza a descongelarse cuando Chris ayuda a Jenna a presentarse a las audiciones de otros programas.

programme.title: El Amor no Necesita Traducción
programme.desc: Julie Walters, estudiante de doctorado en lingüística, habla casi todos los idiomas imaginables. Es una gran creyente de que los idiomas se aprenden mejor haciendo actividades divertidas. Las cosas se ponen patas arriba para Julie cuando un empleado de un museo se pone en contacto con ella para que le dé clases de francés.

programme.title: Siete pistolas para Timothy
programme.desc: Timothy Benson, un joven intelectual e inexperto, hereda una mina de oro y se convierte en objetivo del bandido Rodrigo Rodríguez, que intenta arrebatársela por la fuerza. Sin experiencia en el oeste, Timothy debe confiar en su capataz y sus amigos para endurecerse y defender su herencia.

programme.title: Y en Nochebuena... ¡se armó el belén!
programme.desc: Dos hermanos que se odian se reúnen para pasar la Navidad con su madre, quien intenta unirlos. Enfrentados por viejos rencores y diferencias, tendrán que lidiar con sus sentimientos y conflictos familiares mientras su madre lucha por lograr lo que parece imposible: que sus hijos se reconcilien.

programme.title: Estoy con los hipopótamos
programme.desc: Estoy con los hipopótamos - En África, dos "hermanos" expatriados suelen estar enfrentados, pero ahora tienen un enemigo común. Los hombres de Ormond disparan o capturan gran parte de la fauna salvaje para exportarla y obligan a los lugareños a abandonar sus tierras. Seguida de peleas muy divertidas.

programme.title: La diligencia
programme.desc: Un grupo, que se encuentra con una posta, se une a la lucha contra Geronimo y se aleja de ella.

programme.title: Pistoleros de Arizona
programme.desc: Un pistolero gana 5.000 dólares en una partida de póquer y se convierte en copropietario de un rancho. Antes de reclamar su parte, debe enfrentarse a un poderoso terrateniente corrupto que amenaza y expulsa a los pequeños agricultores para apoderarse del valle.

programme.title: Arizona Colt
programme.desc: El Colt de Arizona, negándose a hacer cualquiera de las dos cosas, se dirige a Blackstone City donde Gordo está planeando un robo.

programme.title: La muerte no cuenta los dólares
programme.desc: Lawrence White vuelve a Owell Rock para vengar la muerte de su padre. Para proteger su identidad y asegurar su venganza, cambia su nombre y contrata a otro hombre para que se haga pasar por él, iniciando un juego peligroso de engaños y justicia.

programme.title: Cinco pistolas
programme.desc: Shalee Jethro (Dorothy Malone) ayuda a su padre a dirigir una estación de diligencias en el desierto.

programme.title: El Coyote
programme.desc: En 1848 los EEUU se anexionan California, los hispanos son ahora discriminados por los yanquis. Para acabar con los abusos Don César ordena a su hijo estudiante que regrese de Europa. Los lugareños se ríen de este ridículo dandi. Pero no todo es lo que parece.

programme.title: Winchester Bill
programme.desc: Ted Shaw, un poderoso empresario minero, controla casi todas las minas de oro de la región, excepto la de Sam Wilson, que se niega a vender. Tras sufrir un ataque de bandidos contratados por Shaw, Sam recluta al joven pistolero Billy Walsh para proteger su tierra y defender a los mineros.

programme.title: Shango: Pistola infalible
programme.desc: Tras el final de la Guerra Civil, un mayor despiadado mantiene a un pueblo aislado en la ignorancia para conservar su poder. Cuando el ranger Shango es acusado falsamente de asesinato, logra escapar y emprende una lucha contra el corrupto militar para liberar a los habitantes y revelar la verdad.

programme.title: La máscara de cuero
programme.desc: La máscara de cuero - Cuatro años después de un violento secuestro de una diligencia, un sheriff se ve obligado a limpiar su nombre, resolver un atraco a un banco y localizar a un asesino camuflado.

programme.title: Uno después de otro
programme.desc: Uno después de otro - Stan Ross, un pistolero con gafas, llega a Canyon City y se involucra con dos facciones enfrentadas después de que un empleado fuera asesinado por el banquero Jefferson durante un asalto fallido mientras robaba su propio banco.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Ana, víctima de abuso por su profesor, ve justicia tras años de denuncias. Judith, asesinada en Bogotá, revela una red criminal. Valentina, presunto suicidio, resulta ser homicidio. Angelie, con Diamond Blackfan, recibe un trasplante exitoso. Harvey, policía herido, lucha por su recuperación y justicia.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El 13 de marzo de 2015, en Villa Lozada, La Plata, Huila, cuatro miembros de la familia Ramírez fueron brutalmente asesinados. Aunque inicialmente se sospechó un atraco, la investigación reveló que el crimen fue obra de una banda dedicada al apoderamiento ilegal de terrenos en Ciudad Bolívar, quienes buscaban el millonario botín que la familia guardaba, producto de su negocio de comercialización de café.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2010, en Putumayo, Myriam Zamora fue acusada de asesinar a sus dos pequeños hijos e intentar suicidarse. Aunque ella se declaró víctima y refutó las acusaciones de la Fiscalía y de su esposo durante el proceso, no logró presentar pruebas que respaldaran su versión. Sin evidencia que sustentara su inocencia, fue condenada y pasará varios años tras las rejas.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El 17 octubre del 2015, en el corregimiento de Belén, en El Banco Magdalena, dos hombres abusaron y asesinaron a Valeria Peña, una menor de 15 años que logró sobrevivir antes los ataques y dejar un testimonio donde señalaba a José Fernando López como el autor material de su crimen. Sin embargo, un tercer testimonio involucro al hermano de José Fernando y el autor intelectual quien tenía claras intenciones de venganza.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2007, María Cecilia Viva Salas desapareció en Buenaventura, generando conmoción en su barrio. Inicialmente se sospechó de pandilleros, pero la investigación reveló que su esposo Harvey era el responsable. Su hija Pilar, testigo silenciada por miedo, finalmente reveló pistas clave. El rastreo del celular llevó a su cuerpo, hallado en su propia casa. Harvey confesó y fue condenado a 18 años, aunque salió libre tras cumplir la mitad de la pena.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Deibis Mildred y Adolfo González formaron una familia y un negocio exitoso de confecciones en Riohacha. En 2008, Adolfo fue asesinado en su casa, un crimen inicialmente sin resolver. Tres años después, las sospechas recayeron sobre Deibis Mildred, señalada de planear el homicidio junto a un amante para cobrar un seguro de vida. Fue condenada a 40 años de cárcel como coautora del asesinato.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2008, Nidia Yazmín González, madre soltera de 37 años, fue hallada muerta en el río Gámeza, Boyacá, con signos de brutal violencia. Mantenía una relación secreta con Alirio Castro, un hombre casado, posesivo y celoso. Pruebas clave —su cinturón negro en karate y un historial de maltrato— lo señalaron como responsable. Absuelto en 2009, la fiscalía apeló y en 2011 fue condenado a 33 años de prisión.

programme.title: Los Informantes

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: After a few incredible days targeting redfish on the inshore waters of Venice, Louisiana, Eric and Moe Newman bring Rush to the nearshore oil rigs — and that’s where things get wild. The rigs are holding GIANT mangrove snapper, bruiser cobia, and hard-fighting jacks… but getting them to the boat is a whole different story. Fishing heavy structure means short strikes, busted hooks, shredded leaders, and fish that know exactly where to run. Around these rigs it’s not just fishing — it’s full-blown combat. If you want to land one of these beasts, you better bring extra hooks, heavy tackle, and a whole lot of patience. Easier said than done. Venice, Louisiana continues to prove why it’s one of the most action-packed fisheries in the country.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Season 10 is a wrap! Rush takes a moment to look back on some of his favorite moments from battling giant snook and feisty tarpon in Florida, to overnighting at Catalina Island, and chasing bull redfish in Louisiana. This season was all about getting out there with good friends, making new ones, and enjoying the sport we love. An unforgettable year filled with adventure, laughs, and epic days on the water.

programme.title: Local Knowledge

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The most important fish catch is the one that got you hooked on fishing in the first place, and for many of us that catch happened early in life. In Florida, Rush spends time with his son Kade fishing for huge permit while Ali takes his nephew Duke out for some wholesome yellowtail action in California.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Over a decade after the game changing Longbeard XR was introduced by Winchester, the wait is finally over for their next ground breaking turkey load. After years of perfecting the recipe behind the scenes, Winchester finally unveiled the new Longbeard TSS at a turkey camp in northern Michigan. First watch the jaw dropping Longbeard TSS pattern board testing, then see it go to work on some spring gobblers.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Nestled in the hills of Ohio just west of the Appalachians is a very special deer camp ripe with memories from deer season’s past. With the development of the 350 Legend straight-walled cartridge by Winchester in 2019, a world of opportunities now existed in states like Ohio and Michigan. In this episode, with the 350 Legend in hand, three mature whitetails meet their maker, from the same blind, over the course of three seasons.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: It’s been 60 years since AA was introduced to the shooting sports world. Since that day, an immeasurable number of AA hulls have hit the ground and countless shooters have stood center stage raising a trophy where millions of dollars have been won. Professional and recreational shooters alike have trusted AA for six decades. In this episode, load up for stories of high school, collegiate competitors and the world’s best as they bust clays with the legendary shot shell. - GUESTS: Zach Keenbaum (Team Winchester) Desi Edmunds (Team Winchester) Kayla Wilgus (Team Winchester) Amy Cawley (Team Winchester) Anthony Matarese (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: For the first time in history, the World English Sporting Clays Championship was held in the United States at the incredible M&M Hunting Preserve owned by the Matarese family in New Jersey. Watch as Winchester’s best shooters vie for Gold as they compete against over 2,500 shooters and 17 countries. We’ll also join the Kids and Clays foundation in Florida as they host an event that will most certainly touch your soul.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We join Denny McMahan on this episode at the legendary Thumbtack Ranch in South Texas. Denny was nominated by his wife for Bucks for the Brave program hosted by Trinity Oaks. After dedicating his life to service in the US Army and law enforcement, he now continues the mission by teaching at the police academy. Denny is a true hero in his community - someone who sacrifices his time, his well being, and his life in service to others, never asking for anything in return.

programme.title: Storytellers

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Jennifer Brooks has spent her life answering the call to serve. In this episode of Storytellers, we join Jennifer in the field for a hunt that offers a rare moment to slow down, reflect, and honor a life dedicated to protecting others.

programme.desc: This is the story of the oldest professional ballpark in the U.S. and the determination of its home team, the Black Barons. The voice of Rickwood tells the tale of its pivotal role in The Negro League, Black history and its legacy in American sports.

programme.title: Hometown Tragedy
programme.desc: Three-year-old Kamille McKinney, affectionately known as "Cupcake," is abducted while playing outside a relative's Birmingham home. The ensuing search unifies the city, as residents pray she will be found alive.

programme.title: Primal Rage: Bigfoot Reborn
programme.desc: Lost deep in the forest of the Pacific Northwest, Ashley and Max Carr are stalked by a terrifying creature that might be Bigfoot. Soon they find themselves embroiled in a strange land of Native American myth and legend turned real. Hopelessly trying to survive, with a handful of unsavory locals, they must fight back against this monster in a desperate battle of life or death.

programme.title: The Swerve
programme.desc: The dark secrets of Holly's seemingly perfect life are exposed when an unwanted intruder spins her life out of control forever.

programme.title: Old 37
programme.desc: Disguised as paramedics, two psychopaths intercept 911 calls and hunt down unsuspecting teenage accident victims in a stolen ambulance known as Old 37.

programme.title: Dread The Unsolved Season 1
programme.desc: Documentary web series about unexplained mysteries, urbanl egends and unsolved cases originating and/or trending on the internet.

programme.title: Halloween Party
programme.desc: When her best friend dies mysteriously, college student Grace enlists a talented I.T. student, Spencer, to help her investigate. The two soon discover that the school has a terrible secret - their dorm rooms were once used as a hospice to house dying patients, including The Balloon Babies, monstrously disfigured teens who wore masks twenty-four seven for The Halloween Party.

programme.title: I Will Follow you into the Dark
programme.desc: A young woman who is severely depressed after the deaths of both her parents retreats within herself, only to be drawn out of her depression by an unexpected romance with a man named Adam.

programme.title: Dark Sense
programme.desc: Simon, a young man with exceptional powers, tracks down a serial killer, battling not only his own demons but a government agency that has decided Simon is too dangerous to be allowed to roam free. Based on a bestseller by Peter Flannery.

programme.title: Zone of The Dead
programme.desc: A police-escorted prisoner transport supervised by Interpol sets off to Belgrade. The route leads the transport through Pancevo, where they encounter an ecological disaster and infected people who are trying to kill them.

programme.title: Lost Child
programme.desc: An army veteran returns home to find her brother, only to discover a lost boy in the woods behind her home. After taking him in, she discovers local folklore about a lifedraining spirit that comes in the form of a child; the Tatterdemalion.

programme.title: Tales of Halloween
programme.desc: Ten stories from horror's top directors. Ghosts, ghouls, monsters, and the devil delight in terrorizing unsuspecting residents of a suburban neighborhood on Halloween night. This creepy anthology combines classic Halloween tales with the stuff of nightmares.

programme.title: The Wave
